app_caption: Educational simulation using real public market data. It does not execute trades or use real money.
quote_help: All selected cryptocurrencies are quoted against the same currency so they can be compared.
catalog_warning: The full catalogue could not be loaded ({error}). A temporary minimal list is being used.
no_spot: No spot markets in {quote} were found on {exchange}.
markets_available_live: {count} spot markets available in {quote} · live catalogue
markets_available_reduced: {count} spot markets available in {quote} · reduced catalogue
select_all_help: This can make downloads and Monte Carlo simulations much slower. The common period may also shorten if a coin is recent.
cryptocurrencies_help: This field is searchable: type BTC, ETH, ADA, XRP, etc. The catalogue comes directly from the exchange.
rules_caption: Rules can be edited before running the backtest. For an out-of-sample test, they should then be frozen.
ema_help: Trend: compares a short exponential moving average with a longer one.
rsi_help: Momentum: values range from 0 to 100. The interval defines when points are added.
macd_help: Momentum/trend: compares the MACD line with its signal line.
min_score_help: Only coins reaching this score enter the portfolio.
max_weight_help: Limits how much of the portfolio can be allocated to one coin. Remaining capital stays in cash.
holder_count_help: Each holder buys one cryptocurrency at the beginning and holds it until the end. No further decisions are made.
holder_assets_help: Select exactly one different coin for each holder.
holders_missing: {count} more coin(s) must be assigned to the holders.
rule_ema_summary: - **EMA ({points} point/s):** adds points when EMA{fast} > EMA{slow}. It seeks an upward trend: the recent average is above the longer-term average.
rule_rsi_summary: - **RSI ({points} point/s):** adds points when RSI({period}) is between {minimum:.0f} and {maximum:.0f}. RSI measures momentum on a scale from 0 to 100.
rule_macd_summary: - **MACD ({points} point/s):** adds points when MACD({fast}, {slow}) is above its signal line ({signal}). It seeks positive momentum.
rule_entry_summary: - **Entry:** a coin is eligible if it reaches **{score} points**. Maximum weight per coin is **{weight:.0f}%**; the rest remains in cash.
methodology_info: These rules are mechanical criteria, not predictions. To avoid look-ahead bias, signals calculated from a daily close are executed only at the next session’s open. To keep the experiment defensible, define the rules before the test period and do not readjust them after seeing the result.
error_dates: The start date must be earlier than the end date.
error_holders_exact: Select exactly {count} coin(s) for the holders.
status_running: Downloading data and running the experiment...
fetching_ohlcv: Retrieving public OHLCV for {count} market(s) via CCXT...
holder_data_error: No data are available for the selected holders: {symbols}
simulation_error: The simulation could not be completed: {error}
initial_prompt: Configure the experiment on the left and click **Run simulation**.
result_saved: Result stored in this session · {coins} cryptocurrencies analysed · {holders} holders · period {start} — {end}
random_summary: The technical agent is approximately at the **{percentile:.1f}th percentile** of the {count} random simulations: {better} random agents finished with more capital.
humans_intro: You can upload a CSV with participant decisions. Each decision allocates up to {weight:.0f}% of the portfolio to the selected cryptocurrency; the rest remains in cash. A decision dated t is executed on the first later session.
allowed_choices: Accepted values in `choice`: CASH or any ticker among the analysed cryptocurrencies (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL...).
educational_disclaimer: Educational use only. Backtest results do not guarantee future returns and are not financial advice.
